remarks: Beautiful Updated two-bedroom, 2 1/2-bathroom, end-unit Townhouse in Indian River Green. This unit is filled with bright, natural light. There are hardwood floors throughout. A spacious living room with sliders leads to a private, flagstone patio for relaxing outdoors. Kitchen is showered with natural light from a skylight. it boasts stainless steel appliances, a center island, granite countertops and a gas range. Wide, light-filled stairway leads to two ensuite bedrooms. Primary bedroom has a newly renovated bathroom, a walk-in closet, and sliders to a private deck. The second bedroom has a full, updated bathroom. Washer and dryer are located on main level. Walking distance to Westport Train Station. Minutes to shopping, restaurants, and beaches in downtown Westport. Westport Schools.
